verdict.rationale: The evidence shows programmatic access to parts of the crypto surface: Bridge flows can be driven programmatically, the official MCP server exposes Stripe API tools to agents, and machine payments let agents pay programmatically. But no source claims API parity with the Dashboard, and stablecoin payout wallet linking is described as happening in the Express Dashboard. Missing for 10: an explicit API-parity statement, documented API endpoints for each crypto feature (subscriptions, Treasury stablecoin balances, card issuing, payout wallet linking), a discoverable OpenAPI spec at the probed docs paths, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: Programmatically support on-ramps, off-ramps, and crypto-to-crypto flows.
The Stripe Model Context Protocol (MCP) server provides tools that AI agents can use to interact with the Stripe API
Machine payments let agents pay for APIs and services programmatically.
